## Import



TKE kubernetes cluster roll out sequence tag config can be imported using the cluster_id, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Kubernetes/clusterRollOutSequenceTagConfig:ClusterRollOutSequenceTagConfig example cls-6ml650mu
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
